name: Growth

subjectOf.text: The third most important use of blockchain by private investment funds is support for fund growth, which is consistent with anecdotal evidence that returns attainable through crypto investments have no match in traditional finance.
subjectOf.abstract: The third most important category of private investment fund use of blockchain technology pertains to its support for the growth of the fund. This is consistent with anecdotal evidence suggesting that the crypto returns attainable through crypto investments have no match in traditional finance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: based on word cluster coding of fund marketing materials; the return comparison is characterized as anecdotal

subjectOf.text: Because information flow in decentralized systems is optimized through dynamic feedback effects, such systems mutate and change easily, which makes them more attack resistant and allows them to grow very quickly.
subjectOf.abstract: Decentralized systems can also very easily mutate and change because the information flow is optimized through dynamic feedback effects. As a result, such systems become more attack resistant on multiple levels.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323

description: 2 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'growth'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
